column1: # Every despatch of David Humphreys found in this code (Boyd's "Code No. 8"; 994 = "the") on National Archives microfilm.
# Rolls: M43 roll 2 = Despatches from U.S. Ministers to Portugal, Nov. 19, 1790 - Sept. 17, 1793, catalog record https://catalog.archives.gov/id/188790777
#        M31 roll 5 = Despatches from U.S. Ministers to Spain, vol. 4, Oct. 27, 1797 - Oct. 29, 1799, https://catalog.archives.gov/id/188602965
#        M31 roll 6 = same series, vol. 5, Nov. 1, 1799 - April 26, 1806, https://catalog.archives.gov/id/188603515
# Frame = the image file number in the catalog record (M31-005-0294 = roll 5, image 0294).
# state: interlined = the State Department clerk's decipherment written between the lines; separate sheet = decipherment
#        on a following leaf; bare = no decipherment on or after this copy.
# How the rolls were searched: M43 rolls 2 and 3 and M31 rolls 4, 5 and 6 paged in full by image and by our own OCR;
# M31 roll 7 frames 0003-0214 likewise; M31 roll 3, the rest of M31 roll 7 and M43 roll 4 through the catalog text layer
